name: Nutshell CRM
description:
Nutshell brings your CRM into the conversation. Connect your Nutshell account to Claude and instantly ask questions about your pipeline, look up contacts, track leads, and surface sales insights - without leaving your AI tool. 

Whether you're prepping for a call, checking deal status, or reviewing team performance, your CRM data is always on question away.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Nutshell CRM to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Nutshell CRM to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.nutshell.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Nutshell CRM MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nutshell CRM provides these MCP tools: fetch, get_entity_custom_fields, get_individual_entities, get_user, nutshell_events, nutshell_leads_report, nutshell_list_entity, nutshell_list_entity_field_info, nutshell_list_entity_from_saved_filter, nutshell_saved_filter, and search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Nutshell CRM?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Nutshell CRM in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Nutshell CRM MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nutshell CRM requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Nutshell CRM is developed by Nutshell. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
